start_lidar_ros_node: start a ROS LiDAR node that subscribes to scan_filtered and runs a background scanning thread
get_latest_lidar_scan: get the latest LiDAR scan data as a tuple of timestamp and range-angle-quality readings
review_lidar_scan_callback: review the Lidar class _scan_callback method that converts LaserScan messages to millimeter ranges and degree angles
run_lidar_driver_main: run the lidar_ros_driver module directly as a ROS node that initializes and waits for shutdown
refactor_lidar_lidar_loop: refactor the Lidar class lidar_loop method to adjust the subscriber topic or polling rate
